goal: Consolidate package status and capability discovery into one small suite surface using Pi native command and tool metadata.
plan: Characterize useful discovery, define one contract, query native metadata, retire duplicate routing/catalog paths, and regenerate deterministic build-time inventory.

tasks.title: Characterize useful discovery operations
acceptance: Tests identify useful existing search and status outcomes
Duplicate routing, proxy invocation, and generated fixture responsibilities are identified

approachReasons.tdd: Characterization protects useful search and status behavior.
approachReasons.diagnosis: Existing overlapping discovery paths must be mapped before consolidation.

tasks.title: Define one consolidated command and tool contract
acceptance: One obvious user-facing discovery command is defined
Contract does not proxy commands that can be invoked directly
Generated release fixtures remain build-time concerns

approachReasons.accessibility-ux: A single obvious discovery entry point depends on clear naming and concise output.

tasks.title: Implement native metadata queries
acceptance: Implementation uses pi.getCommands(), pi.getAllTools(), and canonical sourceInfo
Useful search and status behavior is preserved

approachReasons.tdd: Metadata search and status results require regression tests.
approachReasons.performance: Queries should use native metadata without redundant discovery scans.

tasks.title: Retire duplicate routing and catalog behavior
acceptance: Duplicate routing and catalog surfaces are removed
No proxy remains for directly invokable commands

approachReasons.migration: Overlapping legacy surfaces must be retired while preserving the consolidated contract.

tasks.title: Regenerate inventory and qualify package checks
acceptance: Generated release inventory is refreshed as a build-time fixture
Useful discovery tests and package checks pass

approachReasons.tdd: Freshness and discovery outcomes need deterministic verification.
approachReasons.operations: Build-time inventory generation and package checks affect release reliability.
